target_fidelity.note: The target is a positive active imperative with no modal.

grammaticality.note: “Turn on the light.” is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The dark-room context and instruction are coherent and natural.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice forming an imperative.

determinacy.note: The cue and instruction clearly determine the expected imperative response.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt displays the full target wording in the cue, differing only in capitalization and punctuation.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: No unrelated or advanced grammar is needed.
